method.en: These are vendor-anchored working hypotheses, not calibrated forecasts. Demand factors 0.7/1/1.2, capital factors 1.35/1.2/1.1, utility factors 1.25/1/1 and monthly non-utility costs $2,000/$1,000/$500 were fixed before outcomes. Construction is 1.5/1/0.75 years; first-year ramp 50/75/100%; replacement 2/1.5/1% of gross capex. All cases use four posts, flat real demand, no grant, 10 operating years and the unchanged 6/8-year and 10% NPV gates. These joint stresses have no assigned probability.
method.zh: 这些是由厂家参数出发的工作假设，不是校准预测。需求系数0.7/1/1.2、资本系数1.35/1.2/1.1、电价系数1.25/1/1及每月非电费成本2,000/1,000/500美元均在查看结果前固定。建设期1.5/1/0.75年，首年爬坡50/75/100%，更新预留为总资本2/1.5/1%。均为四枪、实际需求不增长、不计补贴、运营10年，沿用6/8年回本及10%净现值门槛。组合压力情景没有赋予概率。

boundary.en: The 15% loss input is a working grid-to-billed-energy assumption borrowed from Tesla’s different grid-to-battery disclosure. Displayed prices are not verified net receipts. The $470k medium-install illustration excludes hardware tax and does not establish complete utility, civil, land or financing scope. Contingencies, fixed costs and gross-asset reserves are unquoted; reconcile uncovered costs with the $0.10/kWh service package. No inferred savings or credits are admitted. The 35 kWh/session value only converts energy units; it is not a local session forecast.
boundary.zh: 15%损耗是借用Tesla电网至电池披露的电网至计费电量假设，两者计量边界不同。显示售价不是已核净收入。47万美元中档安装示例不含硬件税，也未证明完整接电、土建、土地或融资范围。预备费、固定成本及资产更新预留未获报价，须与每kWh 0.10美元服务包核对未覆盖项目。未计入推定节省或积分。 每次35 kWh仅作电量单位换算，不是本地会话预测。

text.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh per public-network stall per day in Q2 2026, versus 281 in Q2 2025. This observed network aggregate supports testing a higher-energy range, but has different geography, equipment, maturity and pricing. It is not a matched local analogue, a demand ceiling or evidence that utilization always rises.
text.zh: EVgo披露2026年第二季度公共网络平均每枪每日276 kWh，上年同期281。该运营汇总支持研究更高电量区间，但地区、设备、成熟度及价格不同，不是匹配本地的可比站、需求上限，也不证明利用率必然上升。

title.en: The shared downside is not a site forecast
title.zh: 共用保守压力测试不是场地预测

text.en: The $51,392 revenue versus $60,000 fixed-cost comparison is correct. The error would be using that uncalibrated bundle to rule out real sites. Keep it as a historical stress test and investigate distinct local hypotheses.
text.zh: 51,392美元收入低于60,000美元固定成本的计算正确。若据此排除真实场地，就是误用未经校准的参数组合。保留历史压力测试，同时研究本地假设。

title.zh: 四座城市的回本期属于预测

text.en: The reported 4–7 year results were media tests of Tesla’s configurator, not measured realized project returns. They are useful vendor comparisons with different growth, rent, cost and horizon assumptions.
text.zh: 所述4–7年是媒体测试Tesla配置器的结果，不是实测的项目回收记录。它们可以参考，但增长、租金、成本及期限假设不同。

title.en: A better energy anchor, with limits
title.zh: 更相关的电量参照及其边界

text.en: The live Tesla tooltip states approximately 35 kWh per session. We use kWh per post per calendar day as the main demand unit; 35 only converts units. Neither that average nor the US network usage claim establishes local paid demand.
text.zh: Tesla当前原始提示框写明每次约35 kWh。模型以每枪每个日历日的电量为需求单位；35只作单位换算。平均会话及美国网络利用率均不证明本地付费需求。

title.en: Demand charges cannot be counted twice

text.en: The vendor utility field already includes demand and other energy charges at a fleet-based load profile. Higher use may dilute demand charges, but that is not an extra discount on the all-in input; a local interval/tariff model must replace it.
text.zh: 厂家电价字段已按其车队负荷包含需量等费用。增加利用量可能摊薄需量费，但不能在该全包输入上再扣一次；应由当地分时负荷和费率模型替代。

title.zh: 本地新增 / 四枪分期假设

rationale.en: First investigate a four-post retail site: 24-hour amenities and a larger nearby supply gap than the other urban WinCo options reviewed. This is an investigation priority, not a forecast of market share.
rationale.zh: 优先调查四枪零售站：全天配套，本轮城市WinCo候选中近邻供给间距相对较大。这是调查优先级，不是市场份额预测。

anchors.en: Official store identity/hours were reconfirmed. The retained October 29 supply snapshot has no DCFC record within 3 straight-line miles and a nearest record at 4.1 miles. County traffic records cover the 176th Street corridor, but no exact count/year/location join was verified.
anchors.zh: 重核官方门店身份及营业时间。10月29日供给快照中，直线3英里内没有快充记录，最近记录4.1英里。县交通资料覆盖176街，但未核定精确计数、年份与位置的对应。

counter.en: Home charging can dominate suburban demand. Road traffic, city EV registrations and a database gap do not establish paid charging demand. Utility territory, capacity and parking rights remain unverified.
counter.zh: 郊区可能主要在家充电。道路车流、城市EV注册量及数据库空白均不证明付费需求；供电区域、容量和停车权利待核。

test.en: Match road counters to actual entrances; inspect turning access and nearby South Hill charging queues. Obtain comparable paid energy across seasons, then test incremental capture, complete four-post EPC cost and a written utility service offer.
test.zh: 把交通计数点匹配实际出入口，检查转向通行及South Hill竞品排队。取得跨季节可比付费电量，再核增量捕获、四枪完整EPC费用及书面接电方案。

title.en: New-build / neighborhood and commuter retail hypothesis
title.zh: 新增 / 社区与通勤零售假设

rationale.en: First investigate the Bar W retail and commuter catchment. Official amenities and the retained supply gap justify local validation; an overlapping Leander catchment must not be counted twice.
rationale.zh: 优先调查Bar W零售与通勤商圈。官方配套及供给间距支持本地验证；与Leander重叠的商圈不可重复计入。

anchors.en: H-E-B confirms store 774 at 19348 Ronald W. Reagan Blvd, Georgetown 78628, open 06:00–23:00. The city identifies Bar W amenities. Retained inventory places the nearest DCFC about 3.0 miles away, with 16 records within 10 miles.
anchors.zh: H-E-B确认774号门店位于19348 Ronald W. Reagan Blvd、Georgetown 78628，营业06:00–23:00。市政府列明Bar W配套；供给快照最近快充约3.0英里，10英里内16条记录。

counter.en: Tesla normalizes the address to Leander 78641; parcel matching remains unresolved. Store hours do not grant 24/7 charging access. Georgetown city EV totals are not this property’s catchment.
counter.zh: Tesla把地址标准化为Leander 78641，地块匹配尚未解决。门店营业时间不等于全天充电通行权；Georgetown城市EV总量不是该物业商圈。

test.en: Resolve the vendor map point against the official parcel; validate home-charging availability and competing Leander capacity. Obtain host access terms, meter/utility identity, a complete quote and a local demand-transfer case.
test.zh: 把厂家地图点与官方地块对齐，核实家庭充电条件及Leander竞品容量。取得场地主通行条款、电表与供电方身份、完整报价和本地需求迁移依据。

title.en: Corridor hypothesis — access and demand evidence first
title.zh: 走廊假设——先核通行与需求

rationale.en: Investigate corridor stopping demand after the access screen. Sparse inventory makes the US 290 hypothesis worth testing, but the same Texas vendor default is weaker evidence here than a local traffic/capture study.
rationale.zh: 先核通行，再调查走廊停靠需求。供给稀疏使US 290假设值得验证，但相同的德州厂家默认值弱于当地车流与捕获研究。

anchors.en: Official H-E-B identity confirms 1080 West Hwy 290. Retained inventory has one DCFC record within 10 miles, nearest at 9.5 miles. A September 2026 TxDOT notice identifies a corridor study with potential right-of-way and displacement effects.
anchors.zh: 官方H-E-B确认1080 West Hwy 290。供给快照10英里内仅1条快充记录，最近9.5英里。2026年9月TxDOT公告列明走廊研究及潜在征地、搬迁影响。

counter.en: Through traffic may be commuters charging at home. Elgin’s city EV count is small. Planned road changes can undermine frontage access; no direct impact on this parcel has yet been established.
counter.zh: 过境车流可能是在家充电的通勤者，本地EV规模较小。道路规划可能影响临街通行，但尚未证实该地块的具体影响。

test.en: Overlay current roadway concepts with the parcel and entrances before paying for design. Validate directional EV traffic, stopping need and attainable capture with matched paid analogues; do not multiply all traffic by city EV share.
test.zh: 投入设计前先叠加最新道路方案、地块和出入口。结合付费可比样本核实分方向EV车流、停靠需要和可获得的需求；不可把全部车流直接乘城市EV比例。

title.zh: 既有场地扩容或重设计假设

rationale.en: Investigate expansion or redesign of an existing charging property. Recovered plans make a scope-matched cost check actionable; this is not a blank-market greenfield recommendation.
rationale.zh: 调查既有充电物业的扩容或重设计。已取得历史图纸，便于核对相同设计范围的成本；不是空白市场新增站推荐。

anchors.en: The official store address and historical BLD2022-0061 charging plans are documented. Existing supply is recorded at the property, with 55 DCFC records within 10 miles.
anchors.zh: 已有官方门店地址及历史BLD2022-0061充电设计。物业已有充电供给记录，10英里内共有55条快充记录。

counter.en: Historical design load is not spare capacity. Existing operator rights and nearby competition may defeat third-party entry. Reuse savings and incremental demand remain unproved.
counter.zh: 历史设计负荷不是剩余容量。既有运营商权利及竞品可能阻止第三方进入；复用节省和增量需求未证实。

test.en: Identify current equipment, operator and host rights; obtain paid throughput and as-built condition. Compare a genuine upgrade quote with a new four-post build, including only assets demonstrably reusable.
test.zh: 查明现有设备、运营商及场地权利，取得付费电量和竣工状态。把真实升级报价与新建四枪比较，只计入确认可复用的资产。

design.en: Four-post new-build comparison; upgrade savings are not assumed.
design.zh: 四枪全新建设比较；未假定改造可节省成本。

title.zh: 原项目恢复或重设计假设

rationale.en: Keep as a lower-priority redesign or recovery hypothesis. Existing project records create a useful diligence route, but the new vendor inputs make an unsubsidized full new build less attractive than the other four cases.
rationale.zh: 保留为较低优先级的重设计或恢复假设。历史项目资料提供核查路径，但新厂家参数显示，无补贴全新建设弱于其他四处。

anchors.en: The property is documented and Pacific Power offers eligible nonresidential charging-planning assistance. The earlier ODOT corridor agreement was cancelled; nearby DCFC is recorded at 0.2 miles.
anchors.zh: 物业有资料，Pacific Power向符合条件的非住宅客户提供充电规划支持。此前ODOT走廊协议已取消，最近快充记录仅0.2英里。

counter.en: The reason for cancellation, current rights and reusable work are unknown. Nearby competition weakens incremental demand; the vendor utility proxy is higher than in the WA and TX examples.
counter.zh: 取消原因、现有权利及可复用工程待核；近邻竞争削弱增量需求，厂家电费代理值也高于华盛顿州和德州示例。

test.en: Resolve cancellation and asset rights before a new-build bid. Seek an owner-authorized utility assessment and an explicitly scoped restoration quote; separately verify any rebate and measured incremental demand.
test.zh: 新建投标前先查明取消原因和资产权利。取得业主授权的供电评估和明确范围的恢复报价，单独核实返利及实测增量需求。

conclusion.en: Five hypotheses deserve targeted field checks; none is investment-ready. Puyallup and Ronald Reagan are first investigation priorities; Elgin requires an access screen, while Edmonds and Medford require an existing-project redesign scope. The selected pool is not a national optimum.
conclusion.zh: 五个假设值得定向实地验证，尚无可投资资格。Puyallup与Ronald Reagan优先调查；Elgin先核通行；Edmonds与Medford须先明确既有项目重设计范围。本候选池不是全国最优解。

selection.en: Qualitative diligence order, not a return ranking or probability. Based on retail/access evidence, frozen nearby supply, address certainty and a concrete verification route. Five selected from the existing 37; the other 32 were not proven unviable. No new nationwide inventory sweep.
selection.zh: 定性尽调顺序，不是回报排名或成功概率。依据零售与通行证据、冻结供给、地址确定性及可执行验证路径。从既有37处选5处；未证明其余32处不可行，也未重新普查全国。

excludedNumbers.en: No exact Pierce County traffic count enters sales estimates: the year/location alignment could not be fully verified. The 47,400-road figure is a capacity threshold, not observed demand. The Tesla Q3 original scorecard was inaccessible; rounded secondary global totals are not used.
excludedNumbers.zh: 未把Pierce县精确车流数计入销量：年份与位置对应未完全核实。道路47,400数值属于容量阈值，不是观测需求。Tesla第三季度原始记分卡不可访问，未使用次级报道的四舍五入全球总量。
